source: NASA EONET — Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
name: NASA EONET — Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
geometryLevel: point, track or polygon (varies by event)
scheduleDescription: Checked approximately every 60 minutes (external timer plus a GitHub Actions schedule as backup). Actual run times may be delayed.
provides: Open natural events curated by NASA from other agencies — wildfires, severe storms, volcanoes, floods, landslides, dust and haze, snow and temperature extremes — with a link to the original source.
coverage: Global, but limited to events that NASA EONET curators have catalogued; many smaller events are not included.
coverageLimitations: EONET is a curated catalogue, not a warning service: events can be added or closed with a delay, and it assigns no severity level. Storms are shown at their latest reported position. Earthquakes are excluded here because USGS is used directly; sea and lake ice events are excluded as not place-relevant. Some events overlap with GDACS.
licenseOrAttribution: Data courtesy of NASA's Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker (EONET); each event links to its original source agency.
